payload.posture: Read Revelation 11:13–17 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the seventh trumpet brings heavenly voices, worship, wrath, judgment, reward, and an everlasting reign. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
